inputs.label: Mystical Ninja Starring Goemon ROM (USA)
inputs.help: A ROM made from your own North American (USA) cartridge, as .z64, .n64 or .v64.

steps.text: Open Mystical Ninja VR from Library > Unknown Sources. In the start window, choose your ROM in Download. The game checks it and remembers it; after that, press Play.

notes: Quest 3 only. The guide does not name ROM extensions; the payload pattern accepts .z64, .n64 and .v64.
